slides.meta: Fifth month of growth in a row

slides.label: Swiss watch exports · October 2026
slides.headline: CHF 2.46 billion in one month
slides.body: Fifth month of growth in a row. January to October: close to CHF 22 billion, up 3.4% on 2025.

slides.label: Wristwatch value by material · Oct 2026 vs Oct 2025
slides.headline: Steel drove the growth
slides.body: Precious metal is still the biggest category by value, but it was flat.

slides.label: The FH's own warning
slides.headline: Exports are not sales
slides.body: The FH says all three weigh on margins.
